subject: general
question: Which of the following is the most traditional mode of entering into the foreign market?

options.text: Setting up fully owned manufacturing facilities

solution:
The correct answer is __**Exporting.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Exporting:-**

__
 
• **Overview**

 
 
• Requires minimal financial investment compared to establishing operations in foreign markets.
 
• Less risky since companies do not have to set up physical operations abroad.
 
• It allows businesses to test international markets without full commitment to foreign investments.
 
 
 
• **Types of Exporting:**
 
 
• Direct Exporting: The company directly sells to customers in a foreign market.
 
• Indirect Exporting: The company uses intermediaries (like export agents) to sell products abroad.
 
 
 
• **Advantages:**
 
 
• Expand market reach while keeping domestic operations intact.
 
• Easier to exit the market compared to more capital-intensive methods like joint ventures or foreign direct investment (FDI).
 
 
 
• **Challenges:**
 
 
• May face tariffs, trade barriers, and transportation costs.
 
• Requires understanding of local laws and market preferences.
